title: Auxiliar de Professor - Laboratório - Salvador
description:
6 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de máxima qualidade para mais de 90.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local, ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos em um ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes, permitindo desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Gurilândia e a Land School são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação. Essas escolas se baseiam em quatro pilares: Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos, educamos gerações em Salvador, preparando nossos alunos para os desafios atuais com uma educação que une vanguarda e tradição.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social. Contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos, que superam desafios diariamente com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Neste papel, o(a) Assistente de Laboratório será responsável pelo apoio às atividades práticas nas áreas de Ciências da Natureza (Biologia, Física e Química), com foco na segurança, suporte pedagógico e organização do espaço experimental.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Preparar e organizar materiais e reagentes para aulas práticas, conforme orientação dos professores;
  • Garantir o bom funcionamento e manutenção básica dos equipamentos do laboratório;
  • Zelar pela segurança do ambiente, seguindo normas de biossegurança e descarte de resíduos;
  • Auxiliar professores durante as aulas práticas com os alunos;
  • Controlar o estoque de materiais, realizando pedidos de reposição quando necessário;
  • Realizar higienização e armazenamento adequado de materiais utilizados;
  • Apoiar eventos pedagógicos como feiras científicas, clubes de ciências e experimentações interdisciplinares.
Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as responsabilidades principais, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido listada. Assim, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas relacionadas ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:
  • Ensino médio completo (desejável formação técnica em Química, Biologia ou áreas afins);
  • Desejável experiência prévia em ambiente laboratorial escolar;
  • Organização, responsabilidade e atenção a detalhes;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e com adolescentes;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de segurança laboratorial.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Graduação em andamento ou completa nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas, Química, Física ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência em instituições educacionais;
  • Cursos de capacitação em biossegurança;
  • Conhecimento em inglês.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete a salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens. Se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperamos o mesmo de você, incluindo a realização dos treinamentos de safeguarding pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é responsabilidade de todos, e os colaboradores devem refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Todos os candidatos podem ser submetidos a procedimentos de verificação apropriados.

title: Assistente de Soluções Financeiras
description:
Oportunidade: Assistente de Soluções Financeiras

Sobre a Empresa

A Vale Mais Promotora é uma empresa comprometida em oferecer soluções financeiras que vão além do crédito: nosso objetivo é transformar vidas, realizar sonhos e promover o bem-estar de nossos clientes e colaboradores. Acreditamos que o acesso a serviços financeiros deve ser transparente, seguro e alinhado às necessidades reais de quem confia em nós.

Nosso crescimento é sustentado por uma cultura corporativa forte, pautada em princípios fundamentais:

Compromisso com o cliente – O cliente está no centro de tudo o que fazemos. Nosso propósito é atender com excelência, garantindo experiências positivas e soluções eficazes.
Meritocracia – Valorizamos e reconhecemos aqueles que geram resultados sustentáveis e concretos, incentivando um ambiente de alta performance.
Confidencialidade – Trabalhamos com sigilo absoluto , garantindo a segurança e a privacidade das informações.
Colaboração e respeito – Acreditamos que um ambiente produtivo nasce do respeito mútuo e do trabalho em equipe.
Transparência – Nossos processos são conduzidos com clareza, ética e compromisso com a verdade.
Responsabilidade – Fazer o que precisa ser feito, com compromisso e excelência.
Evolução contínua – Estamos sempre em busca de aprendizado e inovação para aprimorar nossos serviços e processos.

Nosso Futuro

Nossa visão é consolidar uma operação própria, transformando lojas em agências financeiras estratégicas , fortalecendo a proximidade com nossos clientes e ampliando nossa presença no mercado.

Se você busca fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza a inovação, a meritocracia e o crescimento sustentável, a Vale Mais Promotora é o lugar certo para sua carreira!

Sobre a Vaga

O(a) Assistente de Soluções Financeiras será responsável pelo atendimento de clientes, apresentando as melhores opções de crédito e produtos financeiros. Este profissional desempenha um papel fundamental na experiência do cliente, garantindo um atendimento eficiente, seguro e consultivo, com foco na conversão de vendas e no atingimento das metas da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades

Realizar atendimento ativo e receptivo (telefone, presencial e digital).
Identificar a modalidade de crédito mais adequada para cada cliente.
Apresentar e vender produtos financeiros de forma consultiva.
Esclarecer dúvidas sobre taxas, contratos e condições.
Coletar, validar e conferir documentação para análise de crédito.
Inserir e acompanhar propostas no sistema YUPPIE.
Monitorar o andamento das operações e solucionar pendências.
Auxiliar na formalização de contratos e assinaturas digitais.
Manter comunicação ativa com clientes, garantindo um excelente pós-venda.
Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe comercial para conversão de leads.
Cumprir metas de vendas e produtividade diariamente.
Seguir normas regulatórias, incluindo a LGPD.
Sugerir melhorias e inovações nos processos comerciais.

Requisitos Necessários

● Ensino Médio completo, Técnico ou Superior (cursando ou concluído).
● Boa comunicação verbal e escrita – Avançado.
● Experiência com atendimento ao cliente e vendas de produtos financeiros – Básico.
● Conhecimento do Pacote Office – Intermediário.
● Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão financeira e plataformas CRM – Básico.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

● Experiência no setor financeiro, bancário ou comercial.
● Conhecimento em técnicas de vendas consultivas e negociação.
● Capacidade analítica para identificação de oportunidades e tendências do mercado.
● Vivência em ambientes de alta performance e metas.

Benefícios e Remuneração

● Plano de Carreira com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
● Salário competitivo + Prêmios por desempenho.
● Assistência médica por teleconsulta e Plano Odontológico.
● Convênios com instituições de ensino para desenvolvimento profissional.
● Folga no dia do aniversário.
● Benefícios por tempo de casa, incluindo folgas especiais.
● Seguro de vida e proteção familiar.
● Convênio farmácia com descontos exclusivos para sua saúde e bem-estar.

Como se Candidatar?

Para participar do processo seletivo, cadastre-se no Solides Jobs e candidate-se à vaga de Assistente de Soluções Financeiras .

A Vale Mais Promotora valoriza a diversidade e incentiva a candidatura de profissionais de todos os gêneros, raças, idades e orientações.

Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e cheio de oportunidades, essa é a sua chance de crescer conosco!

Conhecer, aplicar e interpretar testes pertinentes à área, protocolos de avaliação física (tais como: medidas antropométricas, neuromotoras, metabólicas), bem como reconhecer suas indicações e contraindicações, incluindo o preparo do usuário e mecanismos de funcionamento de métodos, técnicas e equipamentos;
Orientar usuário, quando assim julgar necessário, avaliação médica especializada e consultas compartilhadas com outros Profissionais de Saúde, objetivando identificar restrições e estabelecer linhas de orientação para a apropriada definição de conduta, prescrição e monitoramento de exercícios físicos;
Prescrever e adaptar o tipo, a intensidade, a frequência e duração da sessão de exercícios físicos de acordo com as condições do usuário/grupo, considerando não somente o seu estado de saúde, fatores de risco ou de proteção, mas também as suas capacidades físicas, limitações individuais, objetivos pessoais e preferências, de modo a otimizar os benefícios e a adesão à prática regular da atividade física;
Promover estilos de vida saudáveis às necessidades de indivíduos e grupos, atuando como agente de educação em saúde e de transformação social;
Utilizar fichas de controle, ou equivalentes, para registrar as informações sobre dados clínicos e pessoais, hábitos de vida, uso de medicamentos ou tratamento médico específico, limitações, condições físicas e mentais, comorbidades, sinais e sintomas, barreiras e facilitadores, bem como o programa desenvolvido pelo usuário e posteriormente relatar as informações referentes às atividades assistenciais em prontuário, observando o rol de procedimentos constantes no Sistema de Gerenciamento da Tabela Unificada de Procedimentos, Medicamentos e OPM do SUS (SIGTAP);
Exercer a responsabilidade técnica do Profissional de Educação Física, respeitando o previsto nas normas e regulamentações expedidas pelo Sistema CONFEF/CREFs;
Analisar, descrever e recomendar condições de infraestrutura e materiais, permanentes e de consumo, para o desenvolvimento das atividades de atenção à saúde de forma segura e eficaz, segundo os preceitos das boas práticas; Desenvolver programas individualizados de exercícios;
Explicar os exercícios em detalhes e sugerir alternativas, se necessário;
Monitorar o progresso dos níveis de condicionamento físico;
Realizar RCP e administrar os primeiros socorros em caso de emergência;
Informar sobre as diretrizes de segurança e higiene da academia; Desenvolver um relacionamento positivo e de confiança com os clientes;
Explicar como usar corretamente e com segurança os equipamentos da academia; Manter a organização dos pesos e equipamentos, segundo disposição estabelecida pela Contratante.

description:
POSITION: Hazardous Waste Technician

SEASON: Winfly (Aug 2026 - Oct 2026)

LOCATION : McMurdo Station, Antarctica

SECTOR/DEPT : Six Mile, LLC Antarctica

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Responsible for the collection, processing and packaging of all hazardous waste on station, including legal classification, required packaging and proper labeling of all containers.
  2. Ability to be extremely detail oriented and meet a high level of quality control regarding highly regulated USAP hazardous wastes.
  3. Ability to learn and follow all ACA, EPA, NRC, IMDG, DOT, State, rules and regulations regarding hazardous wastes being shipped.
  4. Ability to complete all documentation and tracking to a high degree of accuracy.
  5. Serves as a station Spill Team Member and is on call for one week out of every four, twenty-four hours a day.
  6. Pick up hazardous waste and associated paperwork from various departments on station, assuring quality of information on Hazardous Waste Identification Sheet (HWIS).
  7. Perform certain classification qualitative testing on items (pH testing, flash point testing, etc.).
  8. Perform labpacking duties if applicable.
  9. Perform safe operation of an articulating forklift (Case M4K).
  10. Quality check all shipping containers and correct discrepancies immediately.
  11. Assist the Solid Waste Department as needed.
  12. Ability to supply manual labor (shoveling) for several hours if needed.
  13. Write spill reports, if applicable.
  14. Regular use of drum dollies, cargo straps, banding, shovels, pallet jacks, power tools and other tools.
  15. Position requires constant physical activity, including bending, consistently lifting and carrying 50 - 70 lbs, reaching and gripping.
  16. Perform ancillary support to station Spill Team, including on-call duties after hours and possible night shift duties.
  17. Agrees with and adheres to the Standard Operating Procedures and tasking responsibilities of the Waste department.
  18. Able to work in a team unit composed of diverse personalities.
  19. Displays self-motivation in physically challenging and atypical work environment; position is comprised of approximately 70% outdoor tasking.
  20. Able to maintain flexibility and positive attitude in a dynamic, fast-paced work setting.
  21. Performs duties in support of Operations Division metrics (as provided by supervisor).
  22. Supports the achievement of ASC metrics, whether metrics are directly or indirectly affected by this position's work activities.
  23. Complies with all ASC Environmental Health & Safety, and Quality Assurance, requirements and goals. Provides documentation to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  24. Works to achieve ASC goals and contractual commitments.
  25. Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  26. Perform other duties as required.
  27. Reports to Hazardous Waste Supervisor.

REQUIREMENTS:

  1. College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).
  2. Strong computer software experience.
  3. Able to lift 50 pounds consistently and wear a respirator.
  4. Valid Driver's License and Passport.
  5. Physically able to be active for 9 hours daily.
  6. Must be able to lift the safety regulation maximum and perform functions requiring repetitive motion required.
  7. Must pass physical qualification assessment.
  8. Able to deploy to Antarctica for length of contract.
  9. A prerequisite of employment for this position is to successfully gain a favorable Tier 1 - Elevated Background Investigation (EBI) result prior to deployment. Candidates hired for this position will be required to complete; online forms, written forms, fingerprint cards and provide additional details and information as requested by NSF Personnel Security.

PREFERRED:

  1. 1 year of Hazardous Materials shipping/characterization or reporting experience or 2 years of Environmental remediation.
  2. 1 year of High School Chemistry or equivalent.
  3. 1 quarter of college General Chemistry.
  4. College degree in Chemistry or Environmental Science.
  5. OSHA HazWOPER 40-Hour, current.
  6. Familiarity with power tools and machinery.
  7. Equipment operating experience.

EDUCATION: College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).

CERTIFICATIONS AND/OR LICENSING REQUIREMENTS: Valid Driver's License and passport valid for six months after end of contract.

OTHER: US citizenship or permanent residency required.

title: Hazardous Waste Technician (Winter 2026) - McMurdo Station
description:
POSITION: Hazardous Waste Technician

SEASON: Winter 2026

LOCATION : McMurdo Station, Antarctica

SECTOR/DEPT : Six Mile, LLC Antarctica

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Responsible for the collection, processing, and packaging of all hazardous waste on station, including legal classification, required packaging, and proper labeling of all containers.
  2. Ability to be extremely detail-oriented and meet a high level of quality control regarding highly regulated USAP hazardous wastes.
  3. Ability to learn and follow all ACA, EPA, NRC, IMDG, DOT, State rules, and regulations regarding hazardous wastes being shipped.
  4. Ability to complete all documentation and tracking to a high degree of accuracy.
  5. Serves as a station Spill Team Member and is on call for one week out of every four, twenty-four hours a day.
  6. Pick up hazardous waste and associated paperwork from various departments on station, assuring quality of information on Hazardous Waste Identification Sheet (HWIS).
  7. Perform certain classification qualitative testing on items (pH testing, flash point testing, etc.).
  8. Perform lab packing duties if applicable.
  9. Perform safe operation of an articulating forklift (Case M4K).
  10. Quality check all shipping containers and correct discrepancies immediately.
  11. Assist the Solid Waste Department as needed.
  12. Ability to supply manual labor (shoveling) for several hours if needed.
  13. Write spill reports, if applicable.
  14. Regular use of drum dollies, cargo straps, banding, shovels, pallet jacks, power tools, and other tools.
  15. Position requires constant physical activity, including bending, consistently lifting and carrying 50 - 70 lbs, reaching, and gripping.
  16. Perform ancillary support to station Spill Team, including on-call duties after hours and possible night shift duties.
  17. Agrees with and adheres to the Standard Operating Procedures and tasking responsibilities of the Waste department.
  18. Able to work in a team unit composed of diverse personalities.
  19. Displays self-motivation in physically challenging and atypical work environment; position is comprised of approximately 70% outdoor tasking.
  20. Able to maintain flexibility and positive attitude in a dynamic, fast-paced work setting.
  21. Performs duties in support of Operations Division metrics (as provided by supervisor).
  22. Supports the achievement of ASC metrics, whether metrics are directly or indirectly affected by this position's work activities.
  23. Complies with all ASC Environmental Health & Safety, and Quality Assurance, requirements and goals. Provides documentation to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  24. Works to achieve ASC goals and contractual commitments.
  25. Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  26. Perform other duties as required.
  27. Reports to Waste Management Specialist.

REQUIREMENTS:

  1. College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).
  2. Strong computer software experience.
  3. Able to lift 50 pounds consistently and wear a respirator.
  4. Valid Driver's License and Passport.
  5. Able to stand for up to 12 hours daily.
  6. Must be able to lift the safety regulation maximum and perform functions requiring repetitive motion required.
  7. Must pass physical qualification assessment.
  8. Able to deploy to Antarctica for length of contract.

PREFERRED:

  1. 1 year of Hazardous Materials shipping/characterization or reporting experience or 2 years of Environmental remediation.
  2. 1 year of High School Chemistry or equivalent.
  3. 1 quarter of college General Chemistry.
  4. College degree in Chemistry or Environmental Science.
  5. OSHA HazWOPER 40-Hour, current.
  6. Familiarity with power tools and machinery.
  7. Equipment operating experience.

EDUCATION: College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).

CERTIFICATIONS AND/OR LICENSING REQUIREMENTS: Valid Driver's License and passport valid for six months after end of contract.

OTHER: US citizenship or permanent residency required.

title: Recruiting Assistant
description:
Brex is the AI-powered spend platform. We help companies spend with confidence with integrated corporate cards, banking, and global payments, plus intuitive software for travel and expenses. Tens of thousands of companies from startups to enterprises — including DoorDash, Flexport, and Compass — use Brex to proactively control spend, reduce costs, and increase efficiency on a global scale.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Recruiting at Brex

The Recruiting team is the growth engine, enabling our teams to hire world-class talent at incredible speed. We partner with leaders across the company to act as talent advisors while keeping candidate experience, diversity, and operational efficiency at the core of all processes. We are collaborative and supportive, always focusing on the success of the team, and help candidates dream big for both their careers and the future of Brex.

What you’ll do

You will join our team of Candidate Experience Coordinators who own, manage, and elevate candidate experience at Brex. You are passionate about offering support to your internal stakeholders - which includes recruiters, sourcers, interviewers, and hiring managers - and will serve as the main point of contact for candidates, all while keeping quality top of mind. The ideal candidate is eager to learn and interested in gaining exposure to all aspects of the recruiting process – from sourcing to full-cycle recruiting, operations, and candidate experience.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Sao Paulo office. You must be willing to work in office at least 2 days per week on Wednesday and Thursday, starting the week of September 1st, 2025, when we open our Sao Paulo office. Employees will be able to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year.

Responsibilities

  • Schedule, coordinate, and manage interviews across multiple time zones in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
  • Serve as the point of contact for candidates throughout their interview process, ensuring a positive experience from start to finish
  • Prioritize daily tasks while maintaining responsiveness with candidates, recruiters, interviewers, and team members
  • Proactively identify process gaps and spearhead projects to improve the coordination function
  • Build trust with your internal stakeholders through effective communication and problem-solving

Requirements

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and prioritize accordingly
  • Keen attention to detail and highly developed organizational skills
  • Comfortable learning new technologies (ex: Greenhouse, CodeSignal, ModernLoop)
  • English proficiency/fluency, both written and speaking (note: interviews will be conducted in English)

*Applications, including resumes, must be submitted in English in order to be considered for the role

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with abrex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the globalHotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is this role?

The Strategic Finance Manager will play a critical role in driving the company’s financial strategy and supporting key business decisions through comprehensive analysis. You will be instrumental in shaping our pricing governance, developing innovative pricing strategies, and assessing market competitiveness. This position requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical skills who can translate financial data into actionable insights. Additionally, you will lead and manage strategic projects that directly contribute to our company’s growth and profitability objectives. Collaboration with senior leadership and cross-functional teams will be essential to ensure alignment and drive impactful initiatives.

This position is based in a hybrid capacity inBelo Horizonte or São Paulo, 1-2 days per week in the office.

In this role, you'll:

  • Build, oversee and govern pricing structures to ensure alignment with company objectives and market standards.
  • Develop and implement cutting-edge pricing strategies while conducting thorough competitiveness assessments to optimize our market positioning.
  • Lead and manage special projects focused on strategic initiatives, leveraging data-driven insights to inform decision-making and enhance business performance.

What You'll Bring:

  • Consulting Experience: Previous experience in a consulting firm, preferably in a role focused on GTM strategies, pricing strategy, business analysis, or financial consulting, which can bring diverse perspectives and methodologies to the team.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and manage large sets of data and translate findings into actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Experience with quantitative analysis and familiarity with pricing models.
  • A curious mindset , with a continuous desire to uncover underlying trends and insights.
  • Exceptional team player , eager to foster collaboration and support cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on approach to problem-solving, demonstrating willingness to dive into the details in finding solutions and demonstrating creativity and resourcefulness to achieve results.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills: Capable of articulating complex analyses clearly and effectively to various stakeholders.
  • Presentation Skills: Experience in creating and delivering impactful presentations to senior leadership and stakeholders, highlighting analytical findings and recommendations clearly.

Nice to Have:

  • Advanced Analytical Tools: Proficiency in advanced analytical tools and software (e.g., Tableau, SQL, R, Python) for more sophisticated data analysis and visualization.
  • Networking Abilities: Existing professional network within the industry that could provide valuable insights and foster partnerships.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven track record of successfully managing and delivering on complex projects within tight deadlines, showcasing effective project management capabilities.
  • Business Acumen : Strong business acumen with the ability to connect pricing strategies to broader business objectives and financial performance.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the industry in which the company operates, enabling a better understanding of market dynamics and competitive pressures.
  • Change Management Exposure : Knowledge or experience in change management processes, especially in implementing new pricing strategies or business models.

At Teachable, we are committed to providing fair and competitive pay (using market data to inform our pay bands), rewarding high performance, and ensuring all employees have the opportunity and ability to impact Teachable’s overall company value. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically following performance review cycles currently conducted annually or in conjunction with a promotion.

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Prefeitura amplia prazo de seleção de 500 cuidadores escolares até este sábado
description:
Prefeitura amplia prazo de seleção de 500 cuidadores escolares até este sábado

21 de Maio de 2025 | 15h 35

A Secretaria Municipal de Educação de Feira de Santana informa que o edital do Processo Seletivo Simplificado para contratação temporária de Cuidadores foi republicado por incorreção nesta quarta-feira (21), com ajustes importantes no cronograma e nos critérios de avaliação curricular. A medida visa garantir maior clareza e equidade ao certame, que oferta 500 vagas para atuação junto a estudantes com necessidades educacionais específicas da Educação Municipal.

Uma das principais mudanças é a ampliação do prazo de inscrições, que agora vai até 23h59 deste sábado (24 de maio). Antes, os candidatos tinham até o dia 23 de maio para se inscrever. As inscrições continuam sendo realizadas de forma gratuita, exclusivamente por meio do link: ( ).

Critérios de pontuação foram reformulados

Outra alteração significativa está no barema de avaliação dos currículos. O novo edital amplia a pontuação máxima de 30 para 100 pontos, incluindo novos critérios como a formação de nível médio, que passa a valer 70 pontos, e reformula a distribuição dos demais itens, como cursos de formação, eventos e experiência profissional. O objetivo é tornar o processo mais objetivo e condizente com o perfil exigido para a função.

Cronograma foi antecipado

Além das mudanças nos critérios de seleção, o cronograma de etapas também sofreu alterações. As fases de análise curricular, publicação de resultados, prazos de recurso e homologação final foram antecipadas em cerca de 10 dias. Agora, a análise dos currículos ocorrerá entre 26 de maio e 4 de junho, e o resultado final será homologado em 16 de junho deste ano.

About Eurasia Group

Eurasia Group is the world's leading global political risk research and consulting firm. By providing information and insight on how political developments move markets, we help clients anticipate and respond to instability and opportunities everywhere they invest or do business. Our expertise includes developed and developing countries in every region of the world, specific economic sectors, and the business and investment playing fields of the future. With our best-in-class advisory and consulting offerings and GZERO Media, the Eurasia Group umbrella provides the marketplace with a complete political risk solution. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Washington, London, San Francisco, Brasilia, Sao Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo, as well as on-the-ground experts and resources in more than a hundred countries. "Politics first” grounds our work: Politics is the lens through which we view the world, and we are committed to analysis that is free of political bias and the influence of private interests.

Job Description: Executive and Admin Support Associate

We are seeking an administrative professional with a minimum of 3 years of relevant office experience within a fast-paced client-services organization. This is an in-office full-time position. Qualified applicants will also have a strong sense of professionalism, punctuality, diplomacy, and confidentiality. Excellent verbal and written communication skills (both in English and Brazilian Portuguese; Spanish a plus); the ability to handle multiple responsibilities and priorities; strong sense of attention to detail; exceptional interpersonal skills and must be proactive rather than reactive .

Preferred candidates must have strong Microsoft Suite experience, experience with business travel booking and expense reconciliation, calendar management, and experience working in a professional services environment. Experience with Salesforce and Concur is a plus but will train as necessary. Executive and Admin Support Associate will report to the Associate Director, Brazil Business Operations.

Responsibilities:

Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Provide calendar, travel (including documentation and travel schedule), and administrative support for Eurasia Group Managing Directors, as directed.
  • Maintain employee Travel profiles in Concur for assigned MDs.
  • Provide back-up support coverage for the Business Travel/Administrative Associate when on PTO, which includes managing the front desk when necessary, answering and transferring calls, greeting guests, escorting them to conference rooms, connecting them with members of the EG staff, and managing office supplies.

Our client is a profitable, stable U.S.-based SaaS company used by over 20,000 property managers globally. Their platform simplifies complex field inspections by capturing photos, videos, voice notes—even offline—and transforming them into detailed reports using AI and advanced integrations.

Com profundo conhecimento em diversos setores, desde a distribuição de autopeças, a comercialização de veículos até a alta gastronomia e o setor imobiliário, o grupo se destaca pela sua dedicação, integridade, comprometimento e espírito empreendedor. Esse compromisso, que atravessou gerações, consolidou o Grupo Comolatti como um dos mais respeitados e tradicionais do setor automotivo brasileiro.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para integrar nosso time de Logística , que seja comprometido e tenha um espírito empreendedor . Valorizamos essas qualidades porque acreditamos que é assim que conseguimos pensar grande , alcançar mais e, dessa forma, ajudar, inspirar e transformar nossos clientes.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  1. Recebimento e Conferência de Mercadorias. Conferir as peças recebidas, de acordo com as notas fiscais para garantir que estejam corretas. Inspecionar as peças quanto a danos ou defeitos.
  2. Armazenamento e Organização. Manter o estoque limpo e organizado, seguindo as práticas de armazenamento recomendadas.
  3. Controle de Inventário. Atualizar os registros de estoque e sistemas de gestão com informações sobre entradas e saídas de produtos.
  4. Separar e embalar autopeças conforme os pedidos recebidos. Preparar os pedidos para envio, incluindo a etiquetagem e documentação necessária.
  5. Manter registros detalhados sobre a movimentação de estoque, incluindo entradas, saídas e devoluções. Reportar discrepâncias ou problemas no estoque para o supervisor.
  6. Seguir as normas de segurança no manuseio e armazenamento de autopeças. Utilizar equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) quando necessário.
  7. Apoio ao Setor de Vendas e Atendimento ao Cliente. Dar suporte à equipe de vendas na localização e fornecimento de peças para atender a pedidos especiais. Auxiliar no planejamento de reabastecimento e reposição de estoque com base nas necessidades e demandas. Colaborar com o supervisor para identificar itens que precisam ser reordenados. Processar devoluções de peças e realizar o controle de peças retornadas. Atualizar o estoque e os registros após o recebimento de devoluções.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist Sao Paulo, Brazil
description:
Our Mission is to be able to say - “Anyone in the World below $15M should fire their Agency tomorrow as nobody can beat this Value & Service at this Price”

We’re looking for a results-driven and experienced Performance Marketing Specialist to join our team.

As a Performance Marketing Specialist at Common Thread Collective (CTC), you will play a key role in scaling client success through strategic media execution and data-driven forecasting. Your expertise will be essential in developing precise performance projections, ensuring campaigns are executed seamlessly to achieve measurable growth. Every decision you make will embody CTC’s core values, reinforcing our dedication to excellence and innovation in performance marketing. At CTC, your trained expertise is invaluable, covering the entire spectrum of CTC’s Strategic Forecasting methods and the foundational principles of media acquisition.

Your role goes beyond delivering measurable business outcomes—it involves proactive collaboration with clients, maintaining clear and transparent communication about strategies, actions taken, and performance relative to forecasts. This ongoing engagement builds trust, strengthens client relationships, and positions CTC as a strategic partner, guiding clients through the complexities of media acquisition and growth strategies.

You stand as a representative and zealous advocate for CTC's unique approach to media acquisition and its accompanying tools.

As a Performance Marketing Specialist, you set a high standard, ensuring that every initiative is executed at the highest level.

You view challenges as opportunities to excel and take great pride in your ability to drive results with precision and impact. At CTC, we embrace the mantra, “Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me,” meaning we take ownership, deliver excellence, and see things through to the end.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone.

They're challenging. In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

AUTODIDACT

  • Naturally curious and an autodidact, able to absorb information quickly and effectively, like osmosis. Your commitment to learning sets you apart, absorbing information swiftly and more effectively than your peers.
  • Your openness to both offer and embrace feedback as an opportunity for growth and implement it proactively, without needing constant direction.
  • Demonstrates resourcefulness, and independently refine your skills without being prompted.
  • Thrives in a self-managed environment, showing autonomy, initiative, and a commitment to continuous improvement and not requiring task lists built by their managers and constant oversight.

UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

  • Embodies a character that inspires pride in both personal and professional associations.
  • Consistently honest, with the courage to acknowledge and communicate hard truths, and the humility to accept them, even when uncomfortable, and never lie in any situation.
  • Displays a high level of self-awareness, taking full ownership of outcomes without resorting to a victim mindset.
  • Values constructive feedback and integrates it, understanding nothing great is built without feedback.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

  • Performs at their best when it matters most, The Enjoyment of Hard Challenges.
  • Demonstrates an unyielding determination to get things done, regardless of obstacles, time constraints, skills needed, or resources.
  • Adapts to changing circumstances, recognizing that true success is about not just meeting, but exceeding what is required.
  • Possesses a deep passion for their work, using creativity and resilience to overcome any hurdle.

What Success Looks Like

NECESSARY SKILLS

TRAINING PERIOD

  • Be willing to put in the hard work required and be hungry enough to go through the training.
  • Being ready and prepared for this to be the hardest job you have ever worked, as you would fundamentally develop a high-leverage new skill.
  • The ability to take feedback and implement it fast.
  • Finish the work to the fullest with quality and on time.
  • Perseverance.
  • Remember and learn from the repetitive doing of the exercises.

ONBOARDING

  • Align with the team and contribute to the team called Brain Trust for Ideas across clients.
  • Manage, align & work with the team members of your pod including Google strategist, Creative Strategist, and Email Strategist.
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.
  • Upkeep of data integrity of your clients across Statlas.
  • Be responsible for the execution of the Prophet system for your clients.
  • Building a Growth Forecast for your clients, including building a Growth map using the Prophet System, data analysis required for the map, and marketing calendar alignment and upkeep with clients.
  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast, making tactical deconstructions and actualizing the projections each day to meet KPIs.
  • Combine data analysis and feedback from clients to develop strategic plans for the future.
  • When it’s time to pivot, you are among the first early adopters.
  • Take a lead in situations that present any obstacle to execution.
  • An insatiable curiosity, and an inability to leave a problem alone until you’ve found one or many different potential solutions.
  • Responsible for the implementation of CTC’s Meta best practices.
  • Build campaigns using our structure and best practices.
  • Upkeep and management of our ideologies and processes throughout the account.
  • Monitoring active campaigns, and adjusting budgets and strategy to ensure the best possible chance of hitting the Daily Projected Targets.
  • Implementing tests in your accounts in an effort to beat your best-performing campaigns.

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

  • Ensuring you are within a 5% Delta to the Forecast.
  • Ensuring daily alignment with the client vs the forecast & strategy.
  • Following the Prophet system execution to 100% within the timeline required.
  • Ensuring all the work is delivered based on the timeline assigned with optimal quality & attention to detail.

Client Communication

  • You are a champion of communication, ensuring the client is aligned on the Growth Map goals and next steps, while making sure everybody on your team has clarity on what is required with exact deadlines.
  • Responsible for sending daily performance updates to the client.
  • Ensure alignment across Strategy and Forecast with the client for every day of the week.
  • Providing weekly updates on the Weekly Strategy Call.

CONTRIBUTING BACK

  • Contributing your learnings back to the system for feedback and continuous improvement.
  • Contributing & collaborating in ideas and learning across teams.
  • Contributing to ideas and learning in future company content production.

NEXT-LEVEL SKILLS

Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English, with a proven ability to communicate persuasively and present ideas clearly to various stakeholders.
  • Skilled in crafting thoughtful, empathetic client messaging that resonates, demonstrating a high level of emotional intelligence.
  • Strong presentation skills, capable of delivering compelling presentations that drive engagement and decision-making.
  • Strong raw talent for data analysis, with an eagerness to learn and improve.
  • Familiarity with data tools, including Google Sheets, with the flexibility to develop advanced skills through on-the-job experience.

Past Experience

  • Historical expertise that compounds to bring a well-rounded perspective and adds value to the role.
  • A breadth of experience from any of the multiple domains, including mathematics, data analytics, business operations, retail, finance, media buying, etc.

Critical Thinking

  • Ability to approach challenges with structured thinking, utilizing logical frameworks to effectively solve complex problems.
  • Naturally adept at dissecting issues and proposing practical, impactful solutions.

Impact

  • Passionate about e-commerce and eager to contribute to a high-performing team at the forefront of the industry.
  • Highly motivated and hardworking, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.
  • Thrives in environments where they can see the direct results of their actions on the business, with a strong preference for roles that offer full accountability and autonomy.

Results

You will merge the Finance and Marketing sides of a business to build a forecasted strategy to help the business achieve its goal.

  • Achieve certification and confidence in our ideology by the end of training, enabling precise execution of the Prophet system to ensure top-quality results for clients.
  • Consistently deliver high-accuracy performance within a 5% delta across the Prophet system’s Growth Map and Statlas.
  • Lead and collaborate with your team to optimize productivity and maintain high-performance standards.
  • Apply best practices in media buying to drive outstanding results, ensuring no one could achieve better outcomes in your role.
  • Maintain client satisfaction levels above benchmark rates, aligning daily on forecasts to exceed client expectations.
  • Adhere to rigorous quality standards in client feedback, forecasting, media buying decisions, and system execution.
  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely and on Target Performance.
  • Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company-wide content, supporting growth and innovation.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • Your supervisor would be Joy Sharma, The Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.
  • As an Accelerator Strategist, you’ll report directly to Joy Sharma —a leader known for his relentless pursuit of excellence and an unmatched passion for growth strategy. Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as a Junior Growth Strategist, supporting your journey every step of the way.

ORIENTATION

  • This role will be client-facing.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • First month: $2,000
  • Second month: $4,000
  • Third month (on average): $7,000 a month
  • 1st Year Annual Range: $64,000-$76,000
  • 2nd Year Annual Range: $100,000-$120,000

This will depend on the amount of clients and the quality of work.

Growth, Transparency, and Fairness in Career Development

  • Progress is Clearly Defined
  • Depends primarily on your experience with the system & quality of execution against it. Following a well-defined path for the first 12 months and how exactly you can grow to be promoted to a Senior Strategist.
  • Fairness and transparency are prioritized
  • Access a weekly performance dashboard to see exactly where you stand compared to team members on both objective and subjective metrics.
  • Pay transparency is upheld for all team members
  • With consistent contract terms and a clear roadmap for increasing earnings, ensuring everyone understands the path to greater compensation. We will also talk monthly about how you can progress.
  • My Commitment to You:
  • You will work harder, learn more than ever before, and “make more than you ever have.” You will gain a diverse skill set while actively contributing to the continuous development of new tools and improvements within our system. In doing so you will have an incredible opportunity for rapid career progression.
  • We will continue to provide you mentorship through every step of your development in the role and promotion from it. We will then continue to provide feedback against the expectation and evaluate against it.
  • Fully remote with the ability to pick your schedule.
  • Embrace autonomy as a core value, with clear expectations, regular 1:1 feedback sessions, and measurable quality benchmarks to support personal growth. Exceptional work is recognized and rewarded, with weekly check-ins for accountability, ensuring you’re consistently challenged and engaged with new opportunities daily.

title: Banco de Talentos
description:
O Grupo Mult é um dos maiores grupos na representação de veículos nos estados do Espírito Santo e Minas Gerais.
Buscamos e valorizamos talentos, pessoas com personalidade, força de vontade e determinação.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Este banco de talentos é destinado a candidatos que desejam fazer parte do nosso time, mas ainda não encontraram uma vaga ideal. Esperamos poder direcioná-lo para alguma oportunidade em breve.

Como funciona o nosso fluxo:

  1. Quando surgir uma vaga na sua cidade, buscaremos em nosso Banco de Talentos por candidatos compatíveis com o perfil desejado.
  2. Se você atender aos requisitos, entraremos em contato através do seu e-mail para convidá-lo a participar do processo seletivo.
  3. Fique atento às notificações e ao seu e-mail.

Seguimos as determinações da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados. Portanto, só poderemos movimentar seu cadastro entre as vagas se você autorizar, no seu cadastro, o armazenamento do seu currículo por tempo indeterminado.

O cadastro no Banco de Talentos não garante uma avaliação ou oportunidade imediata. Entraremos em contato quando houver uma vaga que corresponda ao seu perfil.

História do Grupo Mult

A trajetória do Grupo Mult começou com Maxwell Lage, que em julho de 1993 abriu uma revenda de automóveis multimarcas em Governador Valadares (MG). Com o tempo, a empresa se consolidou como uma das maiores na representação de veículos nos estados do Espírito Santo e Minas Gerais.

Para conhecer melhor essa evolução, confira a linha do tempo a seguir:

  1. 1993: Fundação em Governador Valadares (MG). Rápido crescimento, com filiais em Caratinga, Ipatinga e Teófilo Otoni.
  2. 2004: Tornou-se revendedor oficial Mitsubishi Motors e expandiu suas operações para outras cidades de Minas Gerais e Espírito Santo.
  3. 2012: Inauguração da Kobe Nissan, tornando-se referência nacional e recebendo a honraria Revenda Samurai.
  4. 2020: Tornou-se revendedor oficial Renault em Governador Valadares.
  5. 2021: Inauguração da Multicar Mega Store em Vitória (ES) e conquista da concessão da Royal Enfield.
  6. Hoje: Com 16 lojas, incluindo unidades Nissan, Mitsubishi, Renault, Royal Enfield e uma loja de carros esportivos, além de atuar nos setores imobiliário, de seguros e veículos por assinatura.

About Atacadão

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país. Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras que trabalham diariamente pela missão de oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.

Com infraestrutura moderna e eficiente, o Atacadão disponibiliza aos seus clientes uma variada gama de produtos, com cerca de 10 mil itens, nas categorias de laticínios, hortifrúti, bebidas, doces e biscoitos, higiene pessoal, limpeza, bazar, produtos da linha pet, automotivo, entre outros, além de serviços como padaria, açougue e frios e fatiados.

O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.

Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

O Grupo Carrefour Brasil promove e incentiva a inclusão e a diversidade! Por isso, estimulamos a candidatura de mulheres, profissionais negros (as), LGBTI+ e de pessoas com deficiência.

Responsibilities

Title: Occupational Therapy Assistant
Location/work environment: In facility
Reporting structure: Reporting to Director of Rehab


As an Occupational Therapy Assistant, you help patients get well. You are the person who can bring their power back. In doing this, you will implement occupational therapy programs and activities, follow developed recovery plans, and deliver therapy treatments.

You're a healer and a helper, which is why you got into this line of work.

You're equally adept at addressing the whole patient and seeing them as an individual. You know your goal is to execute a program that will restore, reinforce, and enhance their physical abilities and independence.

You're adaptable to the needs of the patient and can find joy in the variety of the work and the settings.

You're a teammate and are looking for collaboration with your peers, but you're also happy to make referrals to help your patient get the care they need to thrive.

You know that being an Occupational Therapy Assistant means putting patients first; ensuring patients and their families receive the highest quality of service in a caring and compassionate atmosphere.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you!


Powerback Rehabilitation (Powerback) is a new way of delivering recovery, rehabilitation, respiratory, and wellness services to patients across the nation. We deliver an empowered approach to achieving your full potential by providing integrated and individualized solutions. Our reimagined approach to rehabilitation connects directly to the patient experience, which is centered on transforming the road to recovery for everyone and helping patients get their power back. It's patient-centered care that provides a sustainable way of feeling better, moving better, breathing better, and living better.


Working in a company that values growth and understands what it means to be a caregiver is refreshing. Our CEO is a former staff therapist. We offer growth, paths forward, and we are committed to patient-centered care. We are growing, stable, and need people like you, who have a calling to help people thrive.

Isn't it time for you to work with a team where 86% of them know and feel their work makes a difference? So much so, we're certified as a 2023 Great Place to Work.

Now is the time for you to join Powerback.


Powerback has streamlined our hiring process:

1. Applying takes 3 minutes, give or take.
2. You'll hear back from us within 1 business day.
3. If you meet the qualifications, a recruiter will call you for a 10-minute conversation within 2-3 business days, depending on your availability.
4. You will then be presented to the hiring manager.
5. The hiring manager will reach out within a business day to schedule the interview.


This all happens within 1-5 business days from the phone screen.

6. After your interview, the hiring manager makes a quick decision. We aim to accomplish this within the week.
7. If the hiring manager wants to move forward, you will hear from us within a business day, because we are excited to get you started!


Qualifications

1. Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy Assistant Program according to AOTA & ACOTE standards.
2. Initial certification obtained from the National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy.
3. They must be licensed and/or eligible for licensure as required in the state of practice.

title: Instock Manager, Mass Vendor Relations
description:
Amazon.com.br is looking for a smart and driven Instock Manager to join our Mass Vendor Relations team in Brazil. The Instock Manager will be responsible for supporting and executing demand planning to maximize product availability, margins and inventory turns with highly scalable processes for thousands of vendors. This person will have responsibility for ensuring inventory systems and processes are meeting the needs of the business and implementing controls around these. The right candidate thrives in a high energy environment where tactical and strategic activities are expected to be driven in parallel.


The Instock Manager will own driving improvement in inventory availability, increasing inventory efficiency, selection growth and improving purchasing processes. The successful candidate possesses a track record of successful implementation and execution of inventory management practices, leveraging strong analytical acumen and working with cross-functional teams. The position requires an individual who can work autonomously in a highly demanding and often ambiguous environment, with strong attention to detail. The candidate should be able to manage multiple vendors simultaneously and make sure items are always available to our customers in Brazil. This role is located in São Paulo, Brazil.


At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. Therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we engage in and the customers we serve. In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion squad, which is formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed and understands more and more their role in sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of 'Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer.' Understanding our responsibility and our need for change, we are conscientious that 'Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility.' Our affinity groups are built from and by volunteers from different businesses, and they are an active part of our DE&I strategies definition. Besides that, they act as ambassadors of this agenda, and they will support you from Day 1. Remember, at Amazon 'It’s always Day 1.' Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People With Disabilities.


Key job responsibilities

Inventory & Supply Chain Management:

  1. Manage the supply chain to guarantee an efficient inbound and outbound inventory flows among: forecasting, purchasing, and solving receipts problems
  2. Work with vendors to ensure a reliable and operationally effective flow of goods
  3. Deliver maximum available selection in the category
  4. Design seasonal and promotional inventory preparation plan
  5. Control budgets and deliver actions to meet inventory targets
  6. Execute action plans to reduce return/liquidation costs

Operational Efficiency:

  1. Measure and improve purchasing lead times, reduce operational defects, and improve systems to streamline operations between vendors and Amazon
  2. Perform root cause analysis/reporting on operational issues, develop action plans and manage improvements

Project Management:

  1. Work with internal teams to drive system, tools and process improvements/implementation that affect purchasing and vendor management workflow, with emphasis on automating tasks that are currently performed manually
  2. Develop analysis of key business metrics, with emphasis on developing and executing recommendations for improvement
  3. Lead projects from initial development to implementation that will streamline supply systems and processes and drive operational improvements.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree
- Advanced English Proficiency
- Experience in product/category management or commercial planning.
- Experience in logistics, supply chain and/or supply management

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Knowledge of the principles of statistical inventory control
- Experience with process improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma
- Proficiency in SQL and database concepts

description:
Seja muito bem vindos ao Grupo Bringel, inovação e ousadia estão no nosso DNA.

A Lav norte é uma lavanderia industrial especializada em soluções integradas em higienização de enxovais hospitalares, hotelaria e industriais, oferecendo um serviço de alta qualidade e excelência, com foco na segurança e bem-estar de nossos clientes.

  • Seguir rigorosamente procedimentos de segurança no trabalho, utilizar Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) adequados e adotar práticas seguras para prevenir acidentes e lesões durante a operação das caldeiras;
  • Participar de treinamentos contínuos para atualização de conhecimentos técnicos, novas tecnologias e melhores práticas na operação de caldeiras, garantindo competência e eficiência no trabalho.

The Security Manager will be responsible for implementing and overseeing security operationsfor the Mexicali, MX site, ensuring a safe and secure environment for employees, assets, and business operations. The Security Manager will report to the Global Security Director and work closely with site leadership, HR, Legal, EHS, and government agencies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, enforce, and continuously improve security strategies to protect employees, facilities, and company assets.

• Conduct risk assessments, identify threats, and implement mitigation measures to reduce security vulnerabilities across all three sites.

• Manage 24/7 security operations, ensuring effective deployment of security personnel and technology.

• Supervise third-party security vendors, ensuring compliance with company policies, performance benchmarks, and contract requirements.

• Ensure the operational readiness and maintenance of all security infrastructure and recommend technology upgrades to enhance site security.

• Support liaison efforts with law enforcement, government agencies (PNP, NBI, Customs, AHJ), and regulatory bodies to assist with security initiatives and compliance requirements.

  • Organize and participate in internal evaluation committees.

  • Work with project leadership to answer any questions or provide USAID with any requested information about project procurements.
  • Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of procurement, subcontracts and grants required.

  • Demonstrable experience and understanding of procurement procedures of international organizations.

  • Willingness and ability to work efficiently and respectfully with a diverse group of people.

Descrição da Vaga

Na saída da garagem, retirar a FCV e selo de vistoria no setor de tráfego; Conferir se o Check List está no interior do veículo; Realizar vistoria do veículo conforme Check List, anotar / conferir numeração do hodômetro no Check List, sessão aberta e acionamento de campainhas;

Passar com o veículo pela vistoria de saída e recolhida em conjunto com inspetor de frota; No recolhimento do veículo à garagem, após às 18h, acompanhar o abastecimento do veículo (sem sair do veículo), antes de estacionar na sua vaga estabelecida; Durante o processo de estacionamento, verificar se o freio estacionário está acionado;

Realizar o transporte de passageiros adequadamente, prezando pela direção defensiva, segurança dos passageiros, pedestres e demais pessoas envolvidas no trânsito, seguir corretamente itinerário definido; Atender as regras da empresa, da gerenciadora de transporte público e legislação de trânsito vigente; Acatar e atender as solicitações determinadas pela fiscalização/operação; Cumprir os horários determinados pela gerenciadora de transporte; Atender aos itens relacionados a regime de escalas conforme contrato de trabalho; Seguir horários de trabalhos conforme necessidade da empresa, atendendo a convenção coletiva de trabalho vigente; Em caso de acidente, se houver vítimas, prestar socorro ligando para as autoridades competentes de emergência, conforme números informados no verso do Check List; Preencher informações estabelecidas no Check List/Relatório de Ocorrência, conforme procedimento interno; O motorista que trabalhar em linha e horário sem a presença do cobrador deverá cobrar tarifas, de acordo com o valor estabelecido, oferecendo o troco pontualmente de forma correta; Preencher ficha com o número de passageiros (conforme catraca), de acordo com horários estabelecidos na FVC nos pontos de regulagem; Abrir sessão e fechar a mesma, coletando todas as informações do número de passageiros pagantes, isentos, estudantes; Transferir informações coletadas para o sistema SBE (Sistema de Bilhetagem Eletrônica); Gerar extrato e realizar o acerto de valores arrecadados diariamente; Realizar o acerto (de todas as suas jornadas), conforme estabelecido pelo procedimento, não podendo realizar o acerto duplo, nem no dia seguinte; Deverá ser colocado o dinheiro arrecadado no malote, juntamente com o extrato e depositar na boca de lobo; Verificar diariamente edital no setor de arrecadação, de pendências ou sobras de valores arrecadados; Atender aos convites para treinamento e palestras, ou apresentar justificativa legal, caso não haja comparecimento.

title: Senior Data Engineer Data Solutions
description:
Apply now for a career that puts wellbeing first!

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer for our Data Solutions squad in Brazil !

Join our growing Data team at Wellhub and contribute to our data democratization mission: make data accessible to everyone! We are responsible for empowering all teams by providing a scalable and reliable data platform to collect, organize, and process the deluge of data generated daily at Wellhub, following data modeling and governance best practices. Your work will directly impact our goal of enabling all teams to make data-driven decisions and generate business value from data.

We use data and software engineering principles to solve large-scale production challenges. Our infrastructure is completely in the cloud, running Kubernetes, Trino, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, Flink, and more cutting-edge projects.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Design and implement innovative data solutions that enhance automation, efficiency, and productivity for data practitioners across the organization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to architect and develop in-house data solutions that meet organizational needs.
  • Lead the evaluation and integration of cutting-edge technologies to optimize our data and machine learning processes.
  • Ensure robust data architecture and technical product integration, enhancing the overall data ecosystem.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Hands-on expertise in data engineering and architecture, with the ability to follow software engineering best practices.
  • Experience in building in-house solutions to address common data engineering patterns.
  • Proficient in CDC, Flink, Spark, Airflow, Trino, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of data lakehouse design and technical integration with products.
  • Passionate about data democratization, making data accessible and useful across the organization.
  • Familiarity with data management tools (e.g. OpenMetadata) and/or MLOps frameworks (e.g., Metaflow, Kubeflow).
  • Previous experience in a cloud-based infrastructure, preferably using AWS stack is a plus.
  • Experience with scalable data processing and storage solutions (e.g., S3 Management, Trino, Hive Metastore) is a plus.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that experience working with CDC, Flink, Spark, Airflow, Trino, and Kubernetes, as well as an advanced level of English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and well-being of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day.

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @wellhublife and LinkedIn !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

O Coordenador Financeiro trabalha em estreita colaboração com outras áreas da empresa, como RH, Comercial e Operações (logística, estoque, obras, sustentação TI e manutenção), para garantir que as decisões financeiras estejam alinhadas com os objetivos da organização como um todo.

Esse cargo exige um profissional com perfil analítico, capaz de transformar dados financeiros em informações úteis para a gestão do negócio, com foco na maximização de resultados e no controle eficiente dos recursos.

  • Gestão de Equipe: Coordenar e liderar a equipe financeira, promovendo o desenvolvimento e a capacitação dos colaboradores, comunicação impessoal com o time.
  • Controle de Contas a Receber e Pagar: Supervisionar as áreas responsáveis pelo pagamento de fornecedores e recebimento de clientes, garantindo que os prazos sejam cumpridos.
  • Análise de Conciliação Bancária: Analisar a conciliação entre os registros bancários e contábeis, assegurando que os dados estejam corretos e atualizados.
  • Planejamento Orçamentário: Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento da área, alinhando as metas financeiras com a estratégia do negócio.
  • Análise Financeira: Realizar análises financeiras para apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas, como relatórios de contas a receber, liberações de POS, Mobpin e TEF e viabilidade de projetos.
  • Gestão de Custos e ferramentas de estratégias de negócio: Acompanhar e identificar oportunidades para redução de custos, buscando sempre otimizar os gastos da organização. Auxiliar na gestão do fundo de investimento.
  • Compliance e Obrigações Fiscais: Garantir que a empresa cumpra todas as obrigações fiscais e tributárias, evitando multas e problemas com órgãos reguladores.

Formação acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças ou Gestão Empresarial pode ser um diferencial.

Olha só quais experiências e habilidades precisamos que você possua:

  • Experiência: Experiência prévia na área financeira, com pelo menos experiência de vivência em cargos de liderança.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento avançado em Excel, sistemas ERP (SAP), análise de relatórios financeiros, planejamento orçamentário.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Boa capacidade de liderança, comunicação eficaz, tomada de decisões, organização, proatividade e visão estratégica.

Porque vir para Gentil:

Juntos vamos cumprir o nosso propósito de inspirar pessoas que trabalho e empreendedorismo geram prosperidade e transformam realidades. Na Gentil Negócios, o seu protagonismo faz acontecer!

A missão do Assistente de Loja é colocar o cliente como sua prioridade, tanto na área de vendas quanto no processo de conclusão das vendas, com compromisso total de ir além de suas necessidades, para fornecer soluções efetivas que o surpreendam, promovendo o seu encantamento.

Responsibilities and assignments

  1. Encantar os clientes no processo de vendas, atendendo e auxiliando sempre que necessário;
  2. Atuar junto ao cliente no processo de finalização da compra;
  3. Recebimento de valores, realizar a abertura e fechamento de caixa;
  4. Realizar oferta de serviços financeiros como cartão e parcelamentos;

  9. Organizar a área de vendas e vitrines dentro dos padrões definidos pelo merchandising;

  11. Atendimento ao público em geral.

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Gostar de atendimento ao público;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação aos finais de semana;
  • Identificação com moda;
  • Ter facilidade com as ferramentas digitais.

Additional information

E os nossos benefícios?

Para sua saúde e bem-estar:

  • Assistência Médica de plano hospitalar com obstetrícia para todos os níveis hierárquicos e cobertura de todos os procedimentos no rol da ANS (Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar –
  • Dr. Be (telemedicina, telepsicologia, coaching nutricional e coaching esportivo) sem custo para o colaborador e seus dependentes;

  • Wellhub (Gympass) com opção de plano Free;

Para facilitar o seu dia a dia:

  • Vale Transporte;
  • Convênio com restaurantes;
  • Cartão de crédito multicompras;
  • Desconto de Colaborador de até 20% para compras de produtos nas nossas lojas Renner, Youcom, Ashua e Camicado.

Para sua flexibilidade e rotina:

  • Metodologia Balance aplicada junto a liderança e time fortalecendo a comunicação e reconhecimento, bem-estar e estilo de trabalho/ferramentas.

Conheça nossa Ser (Associação dos Colaboradores Renner S.A.):

Fundado em 1986 a Ser promove e impulsiona ações voltadas ao bem-estar e desenvolvimento social e cultural.

Os colaboradores sócios contam com serviços diferenciados, clube de descontos e vantagens com mais de 200 empresas parceiras nas áreas de educação, saúde, alimentação, lazer e entretenimento. Veja nossos principais convênios!

  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Desconto em farmácias de até 35%;
  • Convênio para Pet;
  • Ingressos de cinemas e muito mais.

Pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas em todas as nossas oportunidades.

Process stages

  • Step 1: Registration
  • Step 2: Triagem
  • Step 3: Entrevista Gestor
  • Step 4: Hiring

Sobre a Lojas Renner

O que é que te encanta? ️

Muito além da maior varejista de moda do país, somos um Ecossistema no qual criamos o futuro, inovamos e solucionamos diferentes desafios. Todos os dias aprendemos algo novo, desenvolvemos habilidades e aprimoramos talentos.

Aqui, temos o sentimento de pertencimento, respeitamos o diverso e trabalhamos em um ambiente no qual cuidamos e somos cuidados. Nossa consciência ambiental e social está presente em todas as ações, pois temos compromisso claro com os colaboradores, clientes e fornecedores. Juntos, levamos Encantamento às mais de 600 lojas nos cinco estados do Brasil, além de Argentina e Uruguai.

Se o que te encanta é poder aprender, compartilhar e ensinar. Se o que te encanta é o respeito, a diversidade e a inclusão. Seu lugar é aqui.

Junte-se ao time de 24 mil colaboradores que estão reunidos para encantar ao lado das marcas Renner, Camicado, Youcom, Ashua, Repassa e Realize.

E aí, vem fazer moda responsável com a gente?
